title: Galley stove that burns
what: The dining car's kitchen is told with one wall: a long counter-height range with roasting food on a grill rack, steam columns rising from it into a hood with two extractor fans, a bank of riveted metal cladding, and a marble island in the middle of the room with a cleaver on it. The range top flickers like fire and is a damage sector, so the stove is real: stand on it and you burn. Rats run on the chequered floor.
recipe: Range: sector 117, 768 x 4096 (1.35 x 7.2 m) along a wall, floor at 0.48 bodies above the room (z 10240 vs 18432), ceiling (the hood) 0.72 bodies above the range, floor tile 376, ceiling 255; type 618 kSectorDamage damage_type 1 (burn), shade_wave 7 amplitude 3 frequency 5 on all surfaces. On it: steam flats tile 754 stretched x_repeat 64-144, y 16; grill/food sprites 1741, 1040, 1267, 1269. Fans: flat sprites tile 2548 (cstat 489, floor-aligned) just under the hood ceiling. Island: sector 119, 1024 x 5120 (1.8 x 9 m), 0.48 bodies high, floor tile 294 (marble), its own light channel 125. Room floor 291 (chequered); 4 rats (type 220, tile 1745). Light: switch plates tile 1078 at both doors, tx 126 cmd 3; room rx 126 amplitude -32.
use: Saloon kitchen behind the bar; the market's cook-shop; a crypt-side charnel kitchen for the cultists. The burning range doubles as a hazard to fight around.
